driver_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: driver blanket-required on 22 dispatch leaves. Verified live — DispatchAlertsPage.tsx (queues.alerts) is a card-count aggregate dashboard, zero driver_id; GeofencesPage.tsx (queues.live_map) has zero driver reference; MapView.tsx (queues.map) has a real driver_uuid field + ?driver= URL-filter but never renders an EntityLink/EntityPicker, only filters GPS pins; LoadsPlanner.tsx (planning.loads) renders only load+customer EntityLinks despite the false driver claim; OcrQueuePage.tsx (docs.ocr) has zero "driver" occurrences; BorderCrossingHistory.tsx (misc.geofence_history) has zero "driver"; DispatchChatPage.tsx (misc.chat) uses "driver_direct" only as a thread-type label string; LoadDetailDrawer.tsx's Stops/Documents/Assignment-History tabs (load.drawer.stops/documents/assignment_history) render no driver field, only a driver_instructions_file_id file pointer, or plain-text previous/new driver labels (CLS-UUID-LABEL, never EntityLink); LoadDetailDriverPayTab.tsx (load.drawer.driver_pay) has driver_id only in an unused type, never rendered; CustomsTab.tsx (load.drawer.customs) has zero "driver"; LoadDetailGeofenceTimelineTab.tsx (load.drawer.geofence) treats "driver_pwa" as a stop-source enum, not an identity field; PreSettlementPanel.tsx (load.drawer.pre_settlement/dispatch.panel.pre_settlement) takes a driverId prop used only to fetch data, renders EntityLink kind="settlement"/"load" but never kind="driver"; CancelLoadModal.tsx (dispatch.modal.cancel_load) has zero "driver"; LoadCreateModal.tsx (dispatch.modal.load_create) uses selectedDriverId only for a repair-availability warning banner, no EntityLink/EntityPicker; AuthGatePanel.tsx/PreDispatchValidationPanel.tsx (dispatch.panel.auth_gate/pre_dispatch_validation) use driverUuid only as an authorization/validation query param, no rendered identity; DeadheadOptimizerPanel.tsx (dispatch.panel.deadhead_optimizer) has zero driver field; LoadBolPanel.tsx (dispatch.panel.load_bol) mentions "driver" only in a code comment; RateConUploadPanel.tsx (dispatch.panel.rate_con_upload) has zero "driver" occurrences.

connectivity_column_2026_08_14.note: Vertical wiring sweep (connectivity column, after trailer/customer/vendor/unit/driver/load) read-only investigated every leaf blanket-marked Required for connectivity (nav->route->API->canonical). These leaves have no such chain: static/placeholder surfaces, pure client-side nav Links/redirects, or list-toolbar chrome (search/range/gear) whose shared component (ParityTable/UniversalListToolbar) filters an already-fetched client-side array with no independent backend round-trip. route-mount itself remains proven per-leaf by scripts/verify-wave-b-connectivity-all-modules.mjs; this correction is scoped to leaves where the deeper nav->route->API->canonical claim doesn't apply at all.
